subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

I am trying my best to __give in__ junk food.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'give up'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. 
 
• Here,** 'give up' **should be used instead of** 'give in'.**
 
• **'Give up'** is **a phrasal verb.**
 
• It means** 'to stop trying to do something; to accept that you cannot do something'**. (कुछ करने की कोशिश को रोक देना; किसी काम को करने में अपनी असमर्थता को मान लेना)
 
 
• *Example: They **gave up** once the other team had scored their third goal.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *I am trying my best to __**give up**__ junk food.*
